summary.intent: Plan and fully execute Phase 58 (IPNS Signature-Verify Coverage) of CipherBox via the GSD pipeline, then run the complete ship loop: verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit CLI review, conventional commit reword, and PR creation.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was planned (4 plans, 2 waves), executed, and verified (7/7 must-haves, 89/89 SDK E2E, 913/913 API jest, 0 D-09 regressions). The ship pipeline reached step 5 (SDK E2E green, security SECURED 19/19, two deferred todos captured); PR creation, CodeRabbit CLI review, and commit reword were queued but not yet completed when the transcript ended.

repo: SDK E2E uses TEST_LOGIN_SECRET from apps/api/.env (value: e2e-test-secret-ci-only), not the default SDK_E2E_SECRET. Vitest 3 does not auto-load tests/sdk-e2e/.env. A secret mismatch causes silent 401s that skip the entire suite — executors misclassify this as infra-limited rather than a config error.
crates/fuse cannot dev-depend on api-client or crates/core due to a dependency cycle; shared Rust test vectors must live in crates/fuse/tests/ rather than crates/crypto/tests/.
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL; PR body patches must go through `gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file`.
github-actions[bot] pushes a chore(release) commit to the branch after PR creation — git fetch + rebase required before any subsequent push or it will be rejected.
commitlint and the lint-pr-title CI gate both reject parentheses in commit subjects; parenthetical suffixes like '(7 cases)' in a feat() commit must be moved to the body.
phase.complete flags 5 pre-existing REQ-IDs (IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08) as missing from the traceability table — this is a pre-existing hygiene gap unrelated to phase work.
6 unverified resolve_ipns call sites remain in apps/desktop/src-tauri/ (prepopulate.rs, vault.rs); these were explicitly out-of-scope for Phase 58 and deferred.
The GSD commit helper reports commit_failed as a known false negative; always verify with git log --oneline -1 rather than retrying.
markdownlint CI excludes .planning/ but prettier still runs on files there.

code.finding: New file introducing the resolve_ipns_verified chokepoint that routes all 9 FUSE resolve sites through CBOR cid/sequence validation; scoped fail-closed posture with folder-key descent kept hard fail-closed.
Unchecked seq + 1 arithmetic flagged by code review (WR-01); fixed to use the crate-standard checked_add pattern to prevent sequence overflow silent wrap.
To debug silent 400s from the API during SDK E2E, temporarily add an axios response interceptor logging err.response.data, rebuild the client chain, run one suite, then revert.
TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only is the value that must be passed as SDK_E2E_SECRET when running the SDK E2E suite against the local API instance.

workflow: For multi-crate crypto phases, sequential executors on the feature branch are safer than parallel worktree execution — avoids cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees.

History rewrite (commit subject reword) must happen after all doc commits land on the branch but before the first push; rewording mid-push risks racing in-flight agents that are committing to the same branch.
When an executor crashes mid-task after committing some work, assess actual git state before spawning a continuation — partial commits may be further along than the crash message implies.

SDK E2E full rebuild sequence (crypto → core → api-client → sdk-core → sdk → api) must precede the test run to ensure dist matches what CI sees; running against stale dist is a common source of false failures.

CodeRabbit bundles findings in the PR review body AND as separate inline review threads; resolve-pr-reviews tooling that only fetches threads will show 0 findings even when the review body contains nitpicks.

One subagent completing two sequential plans (spawned for plan N, continued into plan N+1) is harmless when dependency order is respected, but the anomaly should be caught and noted for tracking accuracy.
The GSD pattern mapper (PATTERNS.md, classifies files before planning) runs before the planner and provides file ownership/type context that reduces planner hallucination on crate boundaries.

friction: 58-01 executor crashed mid-task due to an API socket close (connection closed) after committing 3 of 5 tasks; required diagnosing uncommitted diff and spawning a separate continuation agent.

SDK E2E gate was silently skipped by the 58-02 executor (misclassified as infra-limited) due to TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch; required a dedicated gate agent with the correct secret to actually validate the highest-risk gate.
The 58-02 executor overran its scope and also completed 58-03 in the same run, breaking the intended sequential-checkpoint boundary for the non-autonomous plan.
gh pr edit is broken on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL, requiring a manual gh api workaround for PR body updates.
git push and git fetch are blocked in the sandbox environment, requiring sandbox-disabled invocations for every remote operation.
commit_failed false negatives from the commit helper required manual git log verification after every commit to confirm success.
